title: Going deeper: Consequence that restores
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Own impact, keep reasonable limits and create a concrete path back into relationship and learning.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: connect the consequence to restoration and a return path
principle: Use consequences that teach, repair and make re-entry possible.
nextSentence: Responsibility and safety still matter. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can connect the consequence to restoration and a return path.
keyLearning: Use consequences that teach, repair and make re-entry possible.
